arms.fullstage: private20 x16 +shared64, ordinary20 endstate; current hits D2D to fullstage, entry misses H2D once, newly retained expert D2D writeback, contiguous64 full-union kernel

objectives: full reset/warmup/observation/write/flush cycle and parent process wall
boundaries: Two disjoint new document triples; eight episodes inside each engine are dependent repeats, not independent requests/CI samples.
Opposite order also changes document block, so effect drift cannot be assigned solely to order or text. Pair within each block and report both, all slow/failure rows retained.
No SLO selected from results, no maximum-control noise floor or arbitrary multiplier acceptance. Improved requests with offsetting cycle or old-request costs stay tradeoff, not net GO.
Each arm has its own real route/output/cache evolution. No assertion of cross-arm bitwise state or output equality. All fixed requested token work and outputs retained; quality unmeasured.
Qualification refs/poison/readback disabled, same tracing/observer/episode flush categories in all arms. New planner/map/event/trace overhead is included, not subtracted.

GPU preflight perinit/repeat/finish; no claim of continuous exclusivity. Stop on any failed cell, inspect; preserve all attempts. Canonical is first complete valid cell per predeclared label, never outcome-selected.
Current shared wrapper is identical in both arms except chosen executor/private capacity. All eleven source hashes recorded. This is ordinary fullstage adaptation, not an original paper reproduction.

Common runner retains original five warmup episodes; protected warmups use ordinary private21 or20 respectively. Selected executor handles none warmups; all costs retained. This repeated warmup cycle is not sustained-service amortization.
Resources use unique384 total, private336/shared48 versus private320/shared64; legacy scratch_bytes covers only private views. H2D and all D2D counted separately.
Single prior fullstage qualification must pass before GPU performance. Failure remains immutable; any fix requires separately frozen source and new qualification.
continue_if: If compact has lower complete request costs over fullstage, measure sustained-service benefit and appropriate workload coverage; if ordinary fullstage captures benefit, use the stronger common executor for later resource actions without packaging stage separation as novelty.
stop_or_localize: If wrong bytes/state or incomplete accounting, stop validity. If D2D/reduced residence/new execution work offsets savings, localize measured cost; do not kill whole problem.
